# crosswork_syslog_destination (Data Source)

This data source can read a syslog receiver of the notification destinations.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_syslog_destination" "example" {
  id = "cwtest-syslog"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) IP address or host name of the receiver. The controller resolves a host name once, when the receiver is created, and keeps the IP; the value you configure is kept as written and is not compared with the stored IP
- `certificate_id` (String) Id of the certificate of a TLS receiver
- `name` (String) Name of the receiver
- `port` (Number) Port of the receiver
- `protocol` (String) Transport protocol
